content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Manager Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Delhi Project Manager Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Manager: Diploma/Degree in Civil Engineering/Architecture with 02 years of relevant experience. Essential: Ability to prepare, update, and manage drawings and basic technical data in digital interfaces. High proficiency in Excel, MS-Word & Powerpoint. Data Analytics, and Report writing. Desirable: Knowledge of BIM / Revit software Proficiency in drafting (architectural/civil drawings) using AutoCAD or similar CAD software.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age is 35 years. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST Candidates. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Project Manager Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) for hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Project Manager under the advertisement number IITD/IRD/254/2026 for supervising and managing various technical tasks.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Manager position in this recruitment drive conducted by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to directly attend the interview process at the specified venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue on time.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma or Degree in Civil Engineering or Architecture along with at least 02 years of relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for eligible reserved category candidates as per institutional norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive monthly salary ranging from Rs. 64,260 to Rs. 83,840 per month plus HRA @30%.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates. It is completely free to participate in the walk-in selection process.

faq.question: Q10. What selection stages are involved in this recruitment process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager post consists of a Walk-in Test followed by a personal Interview conducted by IIT Delhi authorities.
